title: Stormshield CTI: fake job offers deliver a bespoke control panel
content_md:
Stormshield's CTI team published a new report on a campaign that pairs fake job offers with a custom-built control panel. The post is the vendor's own announcement of the article, published in French under the slug cti-campagne-trigram.
